title: Implement exact selected ADD and SUB contacts on packed HOME fields with paid width decoding and restoration
body:
## Result
Implement the selected exterior +/-1 scalar contacts on complete six-Gamma/packed HOME fields. Two fixed 91-state, six-tape graphs physically decode width, perform exact signed arithmetic, preserve source/header values and restore successful working owners. Late true overflow preserves HOME. Time <=4096(F+1); history increment <=8(F+2); B1 delivery remains charged.

## Checks and limits
The exact selected source and current all-column coefficient convention are pinned. Author normal/optimized replays, full archive re-extraction, 10,912 independent component pairs and six fresh complete-field runs pass with negative controls. Supplied typed packets, frame/grid, rank2 owned MOVE and complete caller admission remain obligations. No new kappa; all five framework assumptions remain.
